category: file host (three paid tiers, one-time billing)

free_tier.stated: Free: 50 GB storage, 512 Mb max upload, 10 upload slots, files deleted 30 days after the last download, download volume '5 GB in 1 days', 256 KB/s, 'Download restriction 1 file / 30 min'.

per_object_cap.stated: Free 512 Mb; Pro 10240 Mb (10 GB); Max 10240 Mb (10 GB)
per_object_cap.notes: The 10 GB cap is stated in Mb as '10240 Mb' on the vendor's own compare table.

retention.notes: The FAQ qualifies it: 'Files on a paid account are kept for as long as the account stays active'.

egress.terms: Free 5 GB/day at 256 KB/s with one file per 30 minutes; Pro 50 GB/day at 10 MB/s with no download restriction; Max 'Download volume: Unlimited' at 'Unlimited' speed. Traffic can also be bought separately at 10 GB / $4.99, 30 GB / $9.99, 100 GB / $19.99 with a balance that 'never expires' and 'works without a premium plan'.
egress.price_per_tb: USD 199.90 per TB bought as 10x100 GB top-ups, or USD 24.99 per month unlimited on Max

interface_detail: Web upload with remote URL upload and FTP upload on both paid tiers. No API is published on the pricing page.
tooling: FTP upload on paid tiers is the only non-browser write path stated. The host is on the Leechall generator list for pull.
chaining: The traffic top-up is what makes this host composable: 100 GB for $19.99 that never expires is a way to buy a single large pull without a subscription, and the balance survives after a plan ends.

limits.value: 5 GB/day free, 50 GB/day Pro, unlimited Max
free tier 256 KB/s and '1 file / 30 min'

limits_note: The 10 MB/s figure on Pro is a speed cap, not a byte cap, and it is the number that decides whether a 50 GB day is reachable in a day: 50 GB at 10 MB/s takes 1.4 hours.
binding_note: Pro's 50 GB/day is 1.46 TB a month, above the 1 TiB target, so Pro clears a user's  scale. Free's 5 GB/day is 150 GB a month, which fails by a factor of seven.

identity_cost.detail: Checkout through Paddle as merchant of record, which also carries the refund terms. The pricing page's checkout step asks only 'Enter your email'.

reliability_note: A premium expiry drops the account to free limits without deleting files, so an archive survives a lapsed month but its download speed does not.
confidence_note: Full three-tier comparison and every price read from the vendor's own table today. A download at Pro speed would raise egress to measured.

evidence.proved: Pro $17.99/30d, $35.99/90d, $109.99/365d with 1024 GB and 50 GB/day; Max $24.99/30d, $49.99/90d, $149.99/365d with 10240 GB and unlimited volume; traffic 10 GB $4.99 / 30 GB $9.99 / 100 GB $19.99; free row 50 GB, 512 Mb, 5 GB/day, 256 KB/s, 1 file / 30 min

price_per_tb_month: USD 17.99 per month for 1 TB stored and 50 GB/day
notes: Max at $24.99 for 10 TB and unlimited volume is the cheapest unlimited-volume offer found, but the 10 GB per-file cap is unchanged from Pro, so a 40 GB remux still has to be split. The 365-day Max at $149.99 is $12.33 a month.
